note: Menu Manipulator filters menu links by the current language and renders per-link icons. All persistent state is the menu_manipulator.settings config object: preprocess_menus_language (bool), preprocess_menus_language_use_entity (bool), preprocess_menus_language_list (map menu_name->menu_name|''), preprocess_menus_icon (bool), preprocess_menus_icon_list (same map shape), menu_link_icon_list (string). The admin form is /admin/config/user-interface/menu-manipulator (route menu_manipulator.settings). A menu is 'active' in a list when its value equals its own machine name, inactive when empty string. Medium cases read back a distinctive language list and the icon list from the live config; hard cases turn language filtering on for the tools menu and icons on for the main menu, verified against real config. Config is owned by this module; scripts restore shipped defaults.

evals.prompt: In the Menu Manipulator Drupal module, which config object holds its settings, and which setting decides whether a given menu's links are filtered by the current language?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in menu_manipulator.settings. preprocess_menus_language is the master on/off switch; preprocess_menus_language_list is the per-menu map deciding which menus are language-filtered (a menu is active when its value equals its machine name).

evals.prompt: Where is the Menu Manipulator settings form in the Drupal admin, what is its route name, and which permission is required to reach it?
evals.expected_output: The form is at Configuration > User interface > Menu Manipulator (/admin/config/user-interface/menu-manipulator), route menu_manipulator.settings, gated by the 'administer site configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: I want to filter a menu tree by the current language in custom code using Menu Manipulator. Which service and method should I call?
evals.expected_output: Call the menu_manipulator.menu_tree_manipulators service (MenuLinkTreeManipulators) and its filterTreeByCurrentLanguage($tree) method; there is also a helper menu_manipulator_get_multilingual_menu($menu_name).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Menu Manipulator configuration and state which menu is currently set to be filtered by the current language.
evals.expected_output: In menu_manipulator.settings the preprocess_menus_language_list has only the 'account' menu active (value 'account'); all others are empty strings.

evals.prompt: Menu Manipulator on this site has a list of available menu-link icons configured. Inspect the live configuration and list those icon names.
On this Drupal site, configure Menu Manipulator so that the 'tools' menu has its links filtered by the current interface language. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In menu_manipulator.settings, preprocess_menus_language_list.tools is set to 'tools' (its own machine name), enabling language filtering for the tools menu.

evals.prompt: Using Menu Manipulator on this site, enable per-link icon rendering for the 'main' menu (add the main menu to its icon list, with icon preprocessing turned on). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In menu_manipulator.settings, preprocess_menus_icon is TRUE and preprocess_menus_icon_list.main is set to 'main'.
